model_selection_basis: HistGradientBoosting selected as PRIMARY because it achieved lower MAE and RMSE on both validation and final test data.
secondary_model_basis: CatBoost retained as SECONDARY because it achieved lower sMAPE and MAPE.
generalization_observation: Both models show higher error on the final test period compared with validation.
business_observation: Both models tend to overpredict low-demand observations and underpredict high-demand observations.
extreme_error_observation: Both models have difficulty predicting extreme demand observations.
test_usage_policy: Final test data was used only for evaluation. No retraining, tuning, feature selection, or model-selection changes were performed.
